items.title: Oracle lands $7 billion Department of War software contract, sending stock higher
items.summary: Investing.com -- Shares of Oracle Corporation (NYSE:ORCL) advanced 2.3% in extended trading Thursday after the database and cloud software giant secured a major defense contract valued at up to $6.99 billion from the U.S. Department of War. The single-award, indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity agreement under the Department of War Enterprise Software Initiative establishes a streamlined, ten-year procurement framework for Oracle’s suite of enterprise products and cloud services.
